hero.title: 1 Week to change your life
hero.description: NLF turns personal change into practice: discover how you move, work on what limits you, and build greater agency in everyday life.
hero.promise: Travis and the NLF team start with your current abilities and one clear standard: what you learn must translate into meaningful progress and practice you can continue at home.
practice.title: Change starts with how you move.
practice.observeBody: Observe how you move and identify what needs a closer look.
practice.tryBody: Try the guidance, get feedback, and compare the difference through practice.
practice.homeBody: Leave with practices you understand, can do independently, and can use in everyday life.
practice.credentials: Verified credentials and real teaching footage will be added once confirmed.
goals.title: What do you want to use your body for?
goals.body: Walk with greater confidence. Bend, stand up, and reach more easily. Keep doing what you love with confidence in your body.
goals.note: Everyone starts somewhere different. Your progress should matter to you.

values.title: The values that guide NLF
values.communityBody: Learn together, support each other, and build a future greater than any of us can create alone.
values.resultsBody: Meet each person where they are. Adapt the guidance so progress matters to the individual.
values.growthBody: Everything is training. NLF is a vehicle for our awakening in every way.
values.humilityBody: A genuine environment of learning does not come from saying that we already know everything.
faq.title: Before you begin
faq.startQuestion: Where should I start if I am new to NLF?
faq.startAnswer: Explore Community Day, Compact, or Fundamental. Structured requires completion of Fundamental.
faq.limitationsQuestion: What if I have movement limitations?
faq.limitationsAnswer: Speak privately with the team before attending. If you are receiving treatment or have movement restrictions, consult your treating professional. Workshops do not replace medical assessment or treatment.
faq.detailsAnswer: Teaching language, Vietnamese support, what to bring, and change or cancellation terms will be confirmed for each session before registration opens.
faq.continueQuestion: How can I continue after the workshop?
faq.continueAnswer: The community and 90-day online programme offer ongoing practice: five days a week, morning and evening slots, one hour per session. Dates and eligibility are to be confirmed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: NLF Vietnam uses your name, phone number, programme selection, language and optional note to handle your enquiry and contact you about the programme. Details are stored in a Neon database in Singapore for access by authorised team members. We record the time and version of your consent; do not submit medical records here. To request correction or deletion, contact NLF through the Zalo advice group and ask for a private conversation. Details are not automatically published or sent to marketing services. Anti-spam identifiers are hashed; raw IP addresses are not stored.
